Open Engineering Plan • v0.5.0 Shipped → v1.0.0 GA Dogfood Cutover

Public Engineering Roadmap

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is built in the open as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software for Windows 11 x64 and ARM64. Our v1.0.0 GA North Star is clear and practical: reaching the exact point where 100% of RaggieSoft's own Windows applications, classic VB6 utilities (StoreTrainer), interactive novels, and supporter audio archives are packaged, signed, updated, and distributed exclusively with Installer Studio—while permanently keeping Community Edition at 100% technical feature parity with Premier Edition.

Shipped Today • v0.1.0 – v0.5.0

Foundation Shipped in Technical Preview

  • 10 Selectable Wizard Styles, Classic Setup Types & WCAG Auto-Contrast (v0.5.0): Selectable era-spanning [UI] WizardLayout styles (including fullscreenteal 1995 ACME #008080 Teal & fullscreenblue #000080 Cobalt washes, wizard95, wizard97, aerowizard, fluentmica, oneclick, passivetoast, and autorun16x9), classic Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom & [SetupType.*] presets, [Billboard.*] slides, and one-click WCAG 2.2 AA Auto-Contrast.
  • Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing & ARM64 /dlib Dispatch (v0.4.5): Dual-layer Public Trust Authenticode signing across every inner C++20 binary, .msi database, and Universal Setup.exe—backed by automatic PE Machine matching for Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll on Windows 11 ARM64 workstations and ImageRemoveCertificate pre-signed template stripping.
  • Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers (v0.4.4): Replaced cryptic numeric Windows Installer InstallLevel inputs with human-friendly Included In tiers (Minimal / Compact, Typical / Express, Complete Only, and Hidden) across the Visual IDE and .rsip grammar.
  • CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & Combined Offline Universal EXE (v0.4.3): Eliminates separate x64 vs. ARM64 download confusion via a compact 64-bit universal outer launcher that pierces Windows 11 Prism emulation through IsWow64Process2 to download or unpack the genuine native silicon installer with SHA-256 verification.
  • 12-View Tree-First Win32 C++20 Visual IDE, Live Dark Mode & Native F1 Help (v0.3.0–v0.4.2): Categorized sidebar tree, dedicated Features and RegEdit-style Registry trees, custom-subclassed Dark Mode push buttons and checkboxes flipping live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet), zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe, Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] runtimes, and 64-bit .MSM merging.

Shipped in v0.5.0

10 Wizard Layout Variations (Incl. 1995 ACME #008080 Teal & Cobalt Washes), Classic & Custom Setup Types & WCAG Contrast Enforcer

  • Eight First-Party Wizard Styles ([UI] WizardLayout):
    • Wizard95: Classic 1995 desktop 3D beveled dialog sheet (#C0C0C0 surface, etched dividers, 164×314 left bitmap rail, and beveled push buttons).
    • Wizard97: Classic enterprise header-banner layout with right-side emblem and bottom-right < Back / Next > / Cancel footer—modernized for Dark & Light Mode.
    • AeroWizard: Command-bar layout featuring a vector GDI+ 30×30 circular ← Back glyph in the top-left command area.
    • FluentMica: Modern Windows 11 native backdrop via DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW / DWMSBT_TABBEDWINDOW) with a unified borderless surface, left-hand vertical step-progress rail, and rounded 8px cards.
    • OneClickSplash: Compact centered ~480×280 friction-free card with one primary Install button and a "Customize installation..." disclosure toggle.
    • PassiveToast: Clean non-interactive /passive & /qb progress banner (centered or docked near the system tray) with UI Automation live-region percentage announcements.
    • FullScreenBlue & FullScreenTeal: Nostalgic 1990s full-screen SETUP.EXE backdrop offering both the classic Cobalt-Blue (#000080 → #000000) gradient wash and the classic 1995 Desktop Teal (#008080) solid setup screen—complete with a drop-shadowed serif title, floating 3D beveled dialogs, optional rotating installation billboards, and a floating 3D Beveled Progress Gauge while keeping modern DPI scaling and screen-reader accessibility.
    • Autorun16x9: Widescreen 16:9 Collector's Edition & digital media launcher menu.
  • Classic Windows 95 & Author-Defined Setup Types ([SetupType.<Id>]): Choose built-in presets like classic Windows 95 Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom or modern Express / Compact / Custom, or define custom publisher Setup Types (such as Developer Workstation, Minimal Portable, or Complete Archive) with custom titles, & keyboard mnemonics, icons, descriptions, live disk-space totals, and explicit feature mappings.
  • Non-Negotiable Windows Contrast Theme Auto-Override (SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST): Every layout automatically bypasses custom gradients, bitmaps, and Mica backdrops whenever a Windows Contrast Theme (Aquatic, Desert, Dusk, Night Sky) is active to paint strictly with semantic OS colors and 2px solid borders.
  • Complete Publisher Branding & Live WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Enforcer ([Branding] & .rswskin): Customize Light & Dark Mode brand colors, banners, sidebars, and billboards—backed by live W3C luminance ratios, a one-click "Auto-Adjust Nearest Accessible Shade" button in the IDE, and automated CI validation in instbuild.exe --validate.
Target v0.6.0 • Next Up

SFX .EXE Builder, Multi-Volume Disk Spanning, Loose Source Media (msiexec /a), .rswpak Packs & Multi-Engine Suites

  • Lightweight Self-Extracting Archive .EXE Builder (PackageKind = sfx + Folder/ZIP-to-SFX AeroWizard): Turn any folder or .zip archive into a zero-dependency, Dark-Mode-aware LZMS self-extracting .exe (zero UAC or Installed Apps registration required) that unpacks to a chosen destination folder and optionally runs a bundled .exe (PostExtractRun) or opens a bundled document (PostExtractOpen, such as a PDF, HTML, or ReadMe guide via the user's default Windows viewer when installed).
  • Multi-Volume Disk Spanning, Uncompressed Loose Source Media & Administrative Installs (msiexec.exe /a): Split multi-gigabyte distributions across numbered external CAB1.cab..CABN.cab volumes (Media table DiskId = 1..N + DiskPrompt), publish uncompressed side-by-side source trees supporting Run from Media (MenuCD) and Run from Network (MenuNetwork), and support full msiexec.exe /a administrative network image extraction.
  • Granular On-Demand Feature Packs (.rswpak): Building on v0.4.3's CPU-aware Smart Web Stub and Combined Offline Universal EXE, split optional multi-gigabyte features (high-DPI assets, offline docs, or language packs) into external LZMS-compressed .rswpak blocks fetched on demand via WinHTTP with SHA-256 + Authenticode verification when selected in SelectionTree.
  • First-Class .NET 11 (net11.0 / net11.0-windows) Runtime Presets: Curated DotNet11Desktop, DotNet11AspNet, and DotNet11Runtime / DotNet10Runtime presets alongside .NET 10.0 LTS.
  • Native Direct Engine (Engine = native | msi) & Multi-Engine Suite Setup (PackageKind = suite): Optional zero-msi.dll transactional extraction backend with rollback journaling and signed Uninstall.exe—plus unified Suite Setup bootstrappers chaining transactional .msi desktop apps alongside multi-gigabyte Engine = native book and music libraries.
Target v0.7.0

From-Scratch Dual Dialog Builders (C++ & Raw MSI.DLL) & RsDialog Scripting

  • From-Scratch C++ & Raw 370×270 MSI.DLL Dialog Designers: Blank-canvas WYSIWYG editors for building custom wizard pages in both SetupWizard.exe ([Dialog.*]) and standalone msiexec SQL tables ([MsiDialog.*] / [MsiControl.*]).
  • RsDialog Standard Library + .rssc Event Hooks: Lifecycle hooks (OnBegin, OnBeforeInstall, OnAfterInstall) paired with procedural RsWelcome(), RsLicense(), RsSetupType(), RsFeatureTree(), RsAskDestPath(), RsAskText(), RsAskOptions(), RsStartCopy(), and RsFinish() dialogs.
Target v0.8.0

Solution & Legacy Project Importers (.slnx, VB6 .vbp Reg-Free COM & .msi) + Restart Manager

  • Visual Studio .slnx / .csproj / .vcxproj Importer: One-click detection of .NET 11 / .NET 10 LTS / VC++ / WebView2 prerequisites, x64 + ARM64 publish folders, icons, and PE versions.
  • Visual Basic 6.0 (.vbp) Importer with Windows 11 WRP & Reg-Free COM Modes: Built for classic apps like StoreTrainer—parses ExeName32, Reference=, and Object=*.ocx lines, honors Windows 11 Resource Protection on inbox SysWOW64 runtimes (msvbvm60.dll), and offers either local SP6 .MSM consumption or zero-elevation Reg-Free COM SxS manifests.
  • .msi Decompiler & Windows Restart Manager (Rstrtmgr.dll): Import existing .msi databases into .rsip projects and gracefully close running app processes during upgrades without OS reboots.
Target v0.9.0

Authenticode & Azure Artifact Signing Studio, White-Label RsUpdate.exe & Guided .MSP Servicing

  • Interactive Authenticode & Azure Artifact Signing Studio: Windows Certificate Store picker (CryptUIDlgSelectCertificateFromStore), Azure Artifact Signing (dlib + MetadataJson) tester, and one-click Dual-Layer WinVerifyTrust verification on both inner Product.msi and outer Setup.exe.
  • Royalty-Free White-Label Auto-Updater (RsUpdate.exe) & Guided .MSP Servicing (--plan-update): Publisher-branded HTTPS updater unlocked across all editions plus automated Microsoft Component servicing lint rules for binary-delta .msp patches and Major Upgrades.
Target v1.0.0 GA & v1.1+

v1.0.0 GA Production Dogfood Cutover & Post-1.0 Enterprise Expansion

  • v1.0.0 GA — Turnkey CI/CD, --emit-winget & 100% RaggieSoft Cutover: First-party GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps tasks, winget-pkgs YAML export, and complete signed install, upgrade, repair, silent (/s), and uninstall validation across every RaggieSoft desktop app, interactive book, and supporter audio archive on clean Windows 11 x64 and ARM64 PCs.
  • v1.1+ Post-1.0 Expansion: One-click disposable Windows 11 Pro Sandbox (.wsb) Setup Capture ("Repackager"), Visual Studio .vsix extension, declarative Windows Services / Firewall / JSON-XML-INI Config Patchers, in-process .MSIXBUNDLE (AppxPackaging.dll), 20+ language I18N + RTL mirroring, and SPDX / CycloneDX --emit-sbom reports.
